digest.component_or_area: live multi-project rehearsal against ephemeral Jira DC instance
propositions: Non-existent project keys in Jira DC instance raise parse errors during JQL queries, causing the inbound fetcher to abort the entire pass without per-project exception handling.
A fake transport masks real failure modes by returning empty results for unknown projects instead of errors, failing to catch cross-project contamination and key validation issues.

The rehearsal must provision and tear down isolated throwaway DC projects per run to model three repo configurations plus empty and unknown project failure paths that two shared Cloud projects cannot supply.
Each mutating scenario must be gated by a preview that asserts the planned mutations target only the intended project with empty intersection against all other configured projects.
A configured project key that never exists in Jira must cause the bridge pass to fail closed and write nothing, with the fail-closed behavior verified before and after sync.
Session-scoped finalizers must delete all scratch projects on every exit path and assert 404 responses, preventing data leakage between test runs while tolerating mid-run failures.
